name: Backend Engineer Screening
steps: Open the ATS and navigate to the New tab for Backend Engineer applicants.
For each applicant, open their profile and read the resume file name to determine Python experience years and referral status.
Apply rules to determine if the applicant is rejected or invited to an interview.
If invited, book a 30-minute slot on the calendar during allowed hours.
Update the ATS status to Interview or Rejected accordingly.

fields.name: python_years
fields.description: Years of Python experience found in resume

invite_template.subject: Interview Invitation
invite_template.body: Hello {name}, we would like to invite you for a 30-minute interview on {slot}.

rejection_template.subject: Update on your application
rejection_template.body: Hello {name}, thank you for your interest in the Backend Engineer role. Unfortunately, we will not be moving forward with your application at this time.

notes: The resume file name is the only source for Python experience; if not explicitly stated, it is currently unclear how to parse this.
The rejection email requires owner approval before sending.
